notes.title: Sweet point and click dino adventure Zid Journey is up on Kickstarter with demo
notes.content:
Love your point and click adventures and want to see more? Zid Journey is a new one from the team behind Zniw Adventure.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2022/10/sweet-point-and-click-dino-adventure-zid-journey-is-up-on-kickstarter-with-demo

notes.title: Zid Journey is coming to Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings friends![/b]

It's time for the big dino news we teased on our social media recently - we can finally share that special "something" with you...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41524054/5bef56acf5199c3d5ee0f9d2b38cbbec72e95e2e.png[/img]

...That's right - [b]Zid Journey heads over to Kickstarter![/b] Thanks to your lovely support we will be able to keep working on the game and continue expanding the aptly fan-named "ZAZ-verse" at a much more steady pace!

[b]The campaign goes live on October 17th[/b] but you can [b]follow our pre-launch page today![/b] 
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/azuremountain/zid-journey

Spreading the word around is much appreciated as well! Let's make it one heck of a dinosaur-sized Kickstarter with a hearty roar!

notes.title: Zid Journey is another colourful and inviting prehistoric adventure coming up
notes.content:
Developer Azure Mountain has announced the second game in the Zid and Zniw Chronicles series, with Zid Journey.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2021/11/zid-journey-is-another-colourful-and-inviting-prehistoric-adventure-coming-up
